main_text.l: ter.9.25. Partic. מִתְנַפֵּל [?] Prosternens se, Esr.10.11. Infinit. לְהִתְנַפֵּל [?] Ut irruat in nos, Gen.43.18. Futurum, וְאֶתְנַפֵּל [?] Et prorui, Deut.9.25.
נָפַל [?] m. Abortus, Abortivum, quasi Cadivum dicas: כְּנֶפֶל טָמוּן [?] Quasi abortus abditus, Job.3.16.

נְפִלִים [?], נְפִלִים [?] m.p. Gigantes, Genes.6.4. Numer.13.34. sic dicti, quasi Dejectores, quòd immani suâ proceritate homines Cadere facerent, ut scribit Aben Esra: vel quasi Defectores, quòd per impietatem à Deo deficerent: vel quasi Irruptores, quòd violenter in homines irruerent, eosq; op-primerent.

מִפֹּל [?] m. Quisquiliae: Deciduum, Amos 8.6. Plur.Con-struct. מִפְּלֵי בִשְׂרוֹ [?] Decidua carnis ejus, Job.41.14. R.Levi scribit, esse partes carnis disilientes & separatas ab invi-cem, ut majorum piscium caro: Tori, Musculi.

מַפֵּלָה [?] f. Cadivum, Cadaver: Casus, Ruina: לִמְפֵלָה [?] In ruinam, Jesa.23.13. Constr. מַפֶּלֶת הָאֲרִיֵה [?] Cadaver leonis, Jud.14.8. Affix. מַפְלָתוֹ [?] Cadivum ejus, id est, cadivum truncum ejus, Ezech.31.13. מַפְלָתְךָ [?] Casus tui, Ezech.32.10.

נָפַץ [?] Sparsus, Disperfus fuit: Praeterit. נָפַץ הָעָם [?] Dispergeret se, vel, Dispergeretur populus, 1.Sam.13. v.11. נָפְצוּ [?] Dispergunt, Jesa.33.3. נָפְצָה [?] Dispersit se; Gene-nef.9.19. Particip. נָפוּץ [?] Dispersum; Jer.22.28. Plural. וְנִפְצוּת [?] Et dispersas, Jesa.11.12. Et active, Infin. וְנָפוּץ [?] Et comminuendo, Collidendo in partes, scil. qua hinc inde dispergantur, Jud.7.19. Pih. נִפֵּץ [?] Dispersit, Dissipavit: Praeter. וְנִפֵּץ [?] Et dissipet, allidendo scil. Psal.137.9. Pyh. Partic. מְנַפְּצוֹת [?] Dissipatos, Jesa.27.9.
מִפָּץ [?] m. Malleus, maximè bellicus verutus,quo equites ute-bantur ad pertundenda arma inimicorum, Jer.51.20.
